name: My Freeze. Their Tears. No Forgiveness
original_name: My Freeze. Their Tears. No Forgiveness
overview:
Adopted into the wealthy Johnson family at six, Sophie was once their most treasured daughter.

But when their biological daughter returns, she becomes the one everyone blames and abandons.

Heartbroken, she enters her brother’s life-changing sleep experiment, leaving behind the family she once loved. Thirty years later, they finally want her back—but she no longer remembers them.
